resumeMessages.content: We need to resolve the hold shipment delay so joker-codex can resume the setting of the medium and hard routes. Please update the inventory as soon as the delivery arrives.

title: Climbing-Gym Route-Setting Tracker
originalRequest: Track and log the route-setting progress, hold inventory updates, and safety grading for the upcoming seasonal boulder reset.
latestMessage: Track and log the route-setting progress, hold inventory updates, and safety grading for the upcoming seasonal boulder reset.

steps.title: Route Setting: Sector A Medium Slab
steps.instruction: Design and set a V4 technical slab route using the new dual-texture pinch holds. Currently blocked due to delayed shipment of the custom bolts required for the volumes.
steps.acceptance: Route is fully set, graded V4 by at least two setters, and safety-tested.

steps.title: Route Setting: Sector B Medium Overhang
steps.instruction: Draft a V5 dynamic coordinate route on the 45-degree wall. Blocked because the required crash pads for the fall zone are currently undergoing maintenance and unavailable.
steps.acceptance: Dynamic sequence is set, safety zone cleared, and test-climbed successfully.

steps.title: Route Setting: Sector C Hard Roof
steps.instruction: Set a V7 roof climb using small crimps. Blocked due to structural truss inspection currently scheduled on Sector C ceiling, preventing high-altitude work.
steps.acceptance: Crimpy roof sequence established, anchors verified, and grade consensus achieved.

steps.title: Route Setting: Sector D Hard Comp Wall
steps.instruction: Create a V8 competition-style coordination run-and-jump sequence. Blocked due to lack of standard volume inventory; awaiting shipment of trapezoidal wooden volumes.
steps.acceptance: Setting completed, volumes securely anchored, run-and-jump sequence successfully demoed.

steps.title: Route Setting: Sector E Hard Arete
steps.instruction: Establish a V9 compression route on the sharp arete. Blocked because the specialized fiberglass macro holds scheduled for this route were damaged during unboxing.
steps.acceptance: Compression arete set, backup holds utilized if necessary, and graded V9 with stable anchor placement.
